metadata.name: Break Chopper
metadata.description: One bar of the Euclid demo, chopped: a StepSequencer lane picks which eighth of the break each eighth-note plays. Chop knobs re-cut the bar while it runs; swing shuffles it; tempo re-times the cuts while each slice keeps its own speed, which is the old jungle trick. Generated by tools/make-break.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
